messages:
leah: Quick sync — want a small, automatable sprint gate for enterprise compliance onboarding (audit exports, BYOK handshake, KMS rotation, retention SLAs). aim: binary pass/fail artifacts we can attach to PRs.

omar: +1. Keep it CI-friendly. suggest 4 small artifacts: export pack, signed manifest, BYOK roundtrip, and retention smoke.

claire: Proposed fastpath checklist (short lines, runnable):

`- export_pack: ndjson export for a 7-day window, produced via /export endpoint`
`- manifest_signed: manifest.json + manifest.sig (service-signer) with signer id`
`- byok_roundtrip: import/export/restore using customer key in sandbox tenant`
`- kms_rotate_check: rotate key in staging -> verify decrypt on shadow copy`
`- retention_smoke: TTL enforcement tested in primary + DR region`
`- soc2_snaps: 2 evidence packs with retrieval timestamps and access audit entries`

ops-bot: Note: retention tier change needs a metadata backfill job; recommend running backfill during canary window. Playbook: <https://internal.redwood/runbooks/retention-migration>. Also validate cross-region TTL enforcement.

legal-iso: Contract items: require 30d notice for retention changes >90d baseline; escrow acceptance = successful signed manifest + verifier logs; require signed-hash (sha256) in manifest. I'll draft clause.

leah: Clarify RTO/RPO per tier? we should list numbers.

omar: Proposal: hot RTO=15m RPO=30s; warm RTO=4h RPO=5m; cold RTO=48h RPO=1h. Put these into the acceptance doc.

claire: Who manages the manifest signing key? ops-managed rotation-protected service key with an auditable key-id. Publish public key in docs.

leah: Action items: claire -> export endpoint + signed-manifest tool; omar -> rotation runbook + signer svc; legal-iso -> contract snippet; leah -> acceptance doc + CI smoke job. estimate: spikes 2d, tests next week.

claire: Example smoke curl for the export pack (to add to CI):
`curl -sS -X POST https://internal.redwood/internal/export \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant":"t-sandbox","start":"2026-07-01","end":"2026-07-07","format":"ndjson"}' \
  | tee export.ndjson && sha256sum export.ndjson > export.sha256 && ./sign-manifest --key /opt/signer/service.key export.sha256 > manifest.sig`

ops-bot: Reminder: also run cross-region validation: export from primary, replicate, then attempt TTL-enforced deletion in DR region to ensure consistency.

legal-iso: I'll draft the clause with escrow acceptance steps and include signer identity and signed-hash requirement. Expect PR in ~24h.

omar: If smoke runs pass on dev, staging and 1 sandbox customer, PM can mark gate ready. keep logs short and attach sha256 + manifest.sig.

leah: Great — I'll publish the acceptance checklist after smoke test logs come in and tag stakeholders. thanks :)
